blocks.heading: Your business problems didn't change. **The cost of solving them did.**
blocks.description:
For years the upgrade was too expensive. So was the custom build, the data project, the legacy replacement. You parked them.

If you sit in the C-suite at an Australian business, someone pitches you on AI most weeks. This session shows what an AI build actually costs and returns in a company like yours.

steps.heading: Which of your parked projects are now worth reopening
steps.description: The build quoted at a number you couldn't justify three years ago. What AI-assisted delivery has done to that price, and how to spot the shelved roadmap items worth pulling back out.

steps.heading: How to get data you can act on out of the systems you already run
steps.description: Dashboards your executives can act on, built in days rather than months. What that took at three Australian enterprises.

steps.heading: What it costs to put AI inside software you already own
steps.description: Real customisation numbers from live Dynamics 365, Salesforce and SAP engagements, including the Australian fintech that took per-transaction cost from $120 down to $5.

steps.heading: When replacing the legacy system finally beats patching it
steps.description: The system that breaks every Monday morning. How to run the numbers on replacement now that the costs have changed.

faqs.question: Will this be recorded?
faqs.answer: Yes. Register and we'll send you the replay even if you can't make it live.

faqs.question: Is this technical?
faqs.answer: No. It's built for business leaders. We talk cost, time and return, not code.

faqs.question: Is this a pitch in disguise?
faqs.answer: No. The session is teaching. At the end Ulysses offers a free 1:1 consultation to anyone who wants to talk through their own business, and that's the extent of it.

faqs.question: What size business is this for?
faqs.answer: Mid-to-large Australian enterprises. If you run custom software, a CRM or ERP, or a legacy system blocking new features, and you have a say over the budget, you're the right person in the room.

faqs.question: How do I join?
faqs.answer: Register on Zoom and you'll get an email with your join link and a calendar invite.

faqs.question: Do I need my camera on?
faqs.answer: No. It's a Zoom webinar, so attendees aren't on camera. You can ask questions in the Q\&A.

faqs.question: Why is it free?
faqs.answer: It's how business leaders get to know SSW. If you'd like help afterwards, you can book a free 1:1 consultation. There's no obligation.
